title: plantago coronopus subsp. commutata
intro: Plantago coronopus subsp. commutata, commonly known as Buck's-horn plantain, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Plantaginaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and skin conditions, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Plantago coronopus subsp. commutata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in soothing irritated tissues and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments.
